crossRefs.note: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

translations.web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
translations.bsb: Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.
translations.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
translations.asv: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.
